;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[2019 Utrecht shooting]]
**A man [[mass shooting|opens fire]] in a tram in the city of [[Utrecht]], [[Netherlands]], killing three people and wounding nine others, before fleeing. [[Terrorism in Europe|Terror]]ism is suspected by authorities. A 37-year-old [[Turks in the Netherlands|Turkish]] man is arrested. [https://www.foxnews.com/world/the-latest-no-indication-utrecht-shooter-knew-victims (Fox News)]
*[[Christchurch mosque shootings]], [[Internet censorship in Australia]]
**[[Telstra]] blocks access to several websites in [[Australia]] for hosting footage of the recent mass shootings in [[Christchurch]], [[New Zealand]], which were [[livestreamed]] on [[Facebook]], including [[LiveLeak]], [[4chan]], [[8chan]], [[Voat]] and the blog [[Zero Hedge]]. [[Optus]] and [[Vodafone (Australia)|Vodafone]] took similar actions but did not list which sites had been blocked. [https://www.9news.com.au/2019/03/19/16/47/telcos-block-access-to-4chan-liveleak (9news)]

;Science and technology
*[[Kamchatka superbolide]]
**[[NASA]] reports that it has detected a huge [[meteor]] explosion in [[Earth]]'s atmosphere on December 18, 2018, above [[Russia]]'s [[Kamchatka Peninsula]]. The explosion went largely unnoticed due to its location. The explosion, which was ten times more powerful than the [[Little Boy|atomic bomb]] dropped on [[Hiroshima]], was the second largest of its kind in 30 years. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-47607696 (BBC News)]
